workflowStatus.description: Per-user pause/resume toggle for an account-scoped system workflow.

envVars.description: Per-account env vars for this skill install (e.g. API keys)

sharedWithTeam.description: Discovery: make this skill visible to team members so they can install their own copy. Does NOT share credentials.

sharedWithOrg.description: Discovery: make this skill visible to org members so they can install their own copy. Does NOT share credentials.

scopeToTeam.description: Credential sharing: set team scope on this install so team members use it directly (same credentials). null/false clears team scope.

scopeToOrg.description: Credential sharing: set org scope on this install so org members use it directly (same credentials). null/false clears org scope.

preload.description: Tenant policy: preload this skill for every user without a more-specific install

storeListed.description: Tenant policy: surface this skill in the portal store

locked.description: Tenant policy: force-install flag. Downstream installs cannot be removed while upstream is locked.

authPolicy.description: Credential policy at this scope level. developer-provides = this level owns creds (locks lower scopes). user-provides = BYOK expected. null = inherit from Skill.apiKeyMode.

block.description: Admin policy (team/org scope): when true, downstream users do not see this skill regardless of upstream preload

mcpOAuthTokensEncrypted.description: Pass null to clear tenant-scope OAuth tokens (Disconnect). Any non-null value is rejected — tokens are set only by the OAuth callback.

enabled.description: Runtime on/off for workflow installs. Blocked when install.enabledLocked=true or upstream disableAllowed prevents it for this scope.

fieldOverrides.description: Per-field overrides for fields listed in Skill.overridableFields. Other keys are silently dropped.

hiddenFromUser.description: Per-install hide toggle. Only makes this install invisible downstream — does not affect other installs of the same skill.

disableAllowed.description: Per-install override of disableAllowed. Can only tighten the upstream value; validated against Skill.disableAllowed at write time.

triggerSources.description: Per-trigger source selection (calendars / inboxes) for this workflow install

contextSourceSelections.description: Per-user context-source selection for a scheduled workflow (calendars / inboxes). Only meaningful on the requesting user's own install.

outputTargetOverride.description: Per-user override of the workflow delivery target. Only applied when the source Skill lists outputTarget in overridableFields.

modelTierOverride.description: Per-user model-tier pick for this workflow install. The author-pinned Skill.modelTier still takes precedence.

overrideValues.description: Per-user workflow schedule and timing overrides. Pass null to revert to skill defaults.

created.description: True when a new user account was created (vs. an existing user found).

addedToTeam.description: True when this call created a new team membership for the user.

alreadyMember.description: True when nothing changed — the user and their team membership both already existed. Callers can surface an "already a member" message.

joinSkipped.description: True when the user/org was provisioned but the team join was skipped because the user already owns a different team with other active members and no automatic conflict resolution was possible. Needs manual reconciliation (ownership transfer).
